cases.name: P0-canonical
cases.reason: canonical signature-positive payload in a single TCP segment

cases.name: P1-boundary-segments
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload split at parser and required-content boundaries

cases.name: P2-many-small-segments
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload split into many small TCP segments

cases.name: P3-retransmission
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload with one byte-identical retransmitted data segment

cases.name: N-wrong-method
cases.reason: GET replaces the required POST method

cases.name: N-uri-extension-changed
cases.reason: URI requests a text file instead of a velocity template

cases.name: N-uri-extension-not-at-end
cases.reason: template extension is present but followed by a query string

cases.name: N-body-velocity-key-changed
cases.reason: body posts a different velocity key

cases.name: N-body-open-brace-absent
cases.reason: body replaces the opening template brace

cases.name: N-body-open-brace-before-key
cases.reason: opening brace appears only before the velocity key it must follow

cases.name: N-body-close-brace-absent
cases.reason: body replaces the closing template brace

cases.name: N-body-close-brace-before-braces
cases.reason: closing brace appears only before the opening brace it must follow

cases.name: N-internal-source-address
cases.reason: canonical payload originates inside the monitored network

cases.name: N-wrong-destination-address
cases.reason: canonical payload is sent to a server outside the monitored network

cases.name: N-flow-not-established
cases.reason: canonical payload is sent without a completed TCP handshake

cases.name: N-wrong-direction
cases.reason: canonical payload is replayed to client; request body stays empty in the response direction

cases.name: N-random-http-request
cases.reason: protocol-valid HTTP request that satisfies no combination of rule predicates
